mapper.select: SELECT * FROM document_import_task WHERE attempt_count < #{maxAttempts} AND ((status='PENDING' AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= statement_timestamp())) OR (status='FAILED' AND next_retry_at IS NOT NULL AND next_retry_at <= statement_timestamp())) ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
SELECT * FROM document_import_task WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE document_import_task SET status='RUNNING',lease_owner=#{owner}, lease_until=statement_timestamp()+(#{leaseMillis} * interval '1 millisecond'),attempt_count=attempt_count+1, claim_epoch=claim_epoch+1,next_retry_at=NULL,updated_at=statement_timestamp() WHERE id=#{id} AND attempt_count < #{maxAttempts} AND ((status='PENDING' AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= statement_timestamp())) OR (status='FAILED' AND next_retry_at IS NOT NULL AND next_retry_at <= statement_timestamp()))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM document_import_task WHERE status='RUNNING' AND lease_until <= statement_timestamp() AND lease_owner <> #{owner} ORDER BY lease_until,id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE document_import_task SET status='FAILED',lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL, last_error_code='WORKER_INTERRUPTED',last_error_message='原执行进程中断', next_retry_at=statement_timestamp()+(#{retryMillis} * interval '1 millisecond')NULL, updated_at=statement_timestamp() WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_until <= statement_timestamp() AND lease_owner <> #{owner}
